incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted family private audiology/coaching payments, financial aid, caregiver time and work costs; finite clinical reference retained.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Weekly attendance and insurance acceptance establish resource mechanisms but not actual additional household payments, aid, alternative private spending or current unique financial families. Existing Early Start, education and insurance alternatives must remain baseline.
directions: Actual aid or replaced private payments may increase resources, while additional visits can increase fees, transport and childcare expenses.
Caregiver time and lost paid work must be net of alternatives and applied to all additional attendance, not discounted by child clinical response.
Taxes, benefit withdrawals and shared family costs require joint net resources; positive overlap only reduces gains.
No device retail value, provider expenditures, public budgets, gross lifetime child wages or ordinary survivor earnings are counted.
